title: Grill the request, not the person
prompt: /grill-me Read exercises/01-clarify/TASK.md and work/01-clarify/brief.json. Ask the unresolved decision frontier. Do not write code or inspect the reference solution.

title: Challenge the plausible claim
prompt: /evidence-first Check the claims in work/02-ground/evidence.json against exercises/02-ground/contract.json. Mark unsupported claims honestly; do not install packages or inspect the solution.
expectedFailures: dependency decision uses the supplied capability

title: Make the test earn its green
prompt: /test-driven-development Read exercises/03-honest-tests/TASK.md. Add a behavioral assertion in work/03-honest-tests/regression.mjs, show it failing on the current code, then minimally fix work/03-honest-tests/incident.mjs.
expectedFailures: learner regression catches the known defect

title: Use the function, not a framework
prompt: /simplify-first Read exercises/04-simplify/TASK.md and conventions.mjs. Simplify only work/04-simplify/incident.mjs; preserve inputs, follow the existing helper, and prove behavior with the lab checks.

title: Trace the boundary error
prompt: /systematic-debugging Reproduce the failure in work/05-debug/incident.mjs using exercises/05-debug/TASK.md. Trace the boundary and state one hypothesis before fixing it; no retry wrapper.

title: Do not disguise failure as success
prompt: /failure-paths Inspect work/06-failure-paths/incident.mjs and exercises/06-failure-paths/TASK.md. Make malformed input fail explicitly; preserve valid empty input and validate failure cases.

title: Review the review
prompt: /review-feedback Evaluate exercises/07-review/comments.json against its contract. Record evidence-backed decisions in work/07-review/review.json, then change only work/07-review/incident.mjs as justified.

title: Prove done, then hand off
prompt: /verification-before-completion Read exercises/08-capstone/TASK.md. Check work/08-capstone/incident.mjs against every acceptance criterion. Fix only the bounded defect, run checks, then record real evidence in handoff.json.
